680397103.accepts_evidence: Not taking new applicants: the site says it has no plans to fund new rounds of open applications for new grantee partners, and remaining funds go to existing partners as it spends down. https://stupski.org/about/faqs/ and https://stupski.org/our-programs/for-grant-seekers/
680397103.contact: Via staff pages and https://stupski.org/contact-us/; 90 New Montgomery St., Suite 1100, San Francisco, CA 94105
680397103.deadlines: None open. The foundation does not expect to issue new grants after 2027.
680397103.eligibility: Existing grantee partners only; no eligibility rules for new applicants are published.
680397103.geographic_limits: Hawaii and the San Francisco Bay Area, chiefly San Francisco and Alameda Counties.
680397103.grant_range_stated: not stated (older, closed invitations offered $50,000 to $200,000 a year for two to three years)
680397103.how_to_apply: No application route for new organizations. Staff can be reached by email or LinkedIn through the staff pages for questions.
680397103.name: Stupski Foundation
680397103.notes: Spend-down foundation: plans to give away all assets by 2029, sped up grantmaking in June 2025, and expects no new grants after 2027. The open invitations found on its blog date from 2021 and are closed. Not a prospect for new applicants, and its geography (Bay Area and Hawaii) is narrow.
680397103.page_dated: Grant seekers page last modified April 11, 2024; FAQ refers to accelerated grantmaking from June 2025
priorities: health (early brain development; serious illness care)
680397103.types_of_support: For existing partners: larger, longer and less restricted grants, co-funding with other funders, capacity building and peer learning.

680480736.accepts_evidence: Donor-advised pass-through. The FAQ says donations made through its platform go to its donor-advised fund, which re-grants them to the nonprofits donors picked in the next monthly disbursement; no grant application exists on the site. Donor-advised grants cannot be applied for (https://www.forgood.org/faq).
680480736.contact: support@forgood.org; 301-683-9492; 6218 Georgia Avenue NW, Suite 1, Box 3111, Washington, DC 20011
680480736.deadlines: none; donations processed in a month are generally disbursed on the 15th of the following month
680480736.how_to_apply: No application. Nonprofits can use the free Nonprofit Portal to track donations and request direct deposit (review takes several weeks); otherwise checks are mailed.
680480736.name: Network for Good
680480736.notes: Network for Good's donor-advised fund now does business as For Good (ForGood, Inc.). Not a prospect in itself; money from it reflects online donors and partner giving platforms.
priorities: None of its own; re-grants follow donors' choices
